summary: Preserve explicit, supported public-source example inputs and keep structured area/hotel discovery help actionable while raw routes stay hidden.
reason: Anonymous keyword searches require a nonempty literal query; invoking the raw route without one produces a source error. Property and directory routes require real source positional identifiers, and dated plan examples must retain the actual supported date/party flags rather than invented shortcuts; refresh sample dates from current evidence on reprint.
validated_outcome: Offline tests confirm each raw example renders in help, every happy-args token names an existing flag or positional label, keyword specifies a literal query and bounded page size, parent group examples exist, and raw root commands remain hidden.
